title: Possible sandbox escape through a renderer frame bridge
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

A sandboxed untrusted renderer must not gain host privileges.

### Actual Behavior

I believe a crafted frame interaction can escape the Electron sandbox and execute a host-side action without consent. I am reporting a possible vulnerability in public.

### Testcase Gist URL

_No response_

### Additional Information

I have not attached the exploit here.
